text:
Lena Cho: quick thread to align on model-move lanes + sales asks. want clear lanes so we can give customers deterministic timelines and SLAs.
Priya Raman: +1. Sales keeps asking for a 'fast-lane' for strategic accounts and a cheaper "slow-migrate" path for long-tail customers. we need criteria.
Tom Becker: propose three lanes: FAST (0-30d opt-in with concierge + credits), STANDARD (60d opt-in with self-serve tooling), HOLD (6mo delay by request, readonly legacy support).
Elena M: for FAST we need a stronger safety net: dedicated canary workers, accelerated rollback windows, and a named AM to coordinate migrations.
Ravi K: on the engineering side, acceptance must be deterministic. baseline checks: API compatibility smoke, tokenizer fingerprint match, and deterministic eval harness pass. Also verify KV cache schema version compatibility.
Priya Raman: sales asks: can we allow a one-time permanent hold for enterprise deals? Legal wants a contract flag and a migration clause with minimum notice.
Lena Cho: we can support permanent holds only when contract flag = "enterprise_hold" and appendix includes migration notice (12mo). Ops needs an on-call escalation path documented.
Tom Becker: what about metrics for launch? I suggest:
- latency_unthrottled_p95 <= 250ms for long-turns (<=512 tokens) on shared-hosted
- embeddings throughput >= 2000/sec for embed-heavy workloads
- quality: macro-intent F1 drop <= 2.5% vs pinned baseline in eval suite
- safety: hallucination delta <= 1.2x on critical prompts
Elena M: those are fine but let's make separate targets per lane: FAST requires stricter latency (p95 <= 180ms) and quality delta <= 1.5%. STANDARD can be looser.
Ravi K: rollout config sample for Console (to wire into rollout UI):
```
staged_rollout:
  lanes:
    - name: FAST
      percent: 3
      duration_hours: 48
      monitors: [latency_p95, error_rate, intent_f1]
    - name: STANDARD
      percent: 20
      duration_hours: 120
      monitors: [latency_p95, error_rate]
    - name: HOLD
      percent: 0
      manual_approval_required: true
  rollback_policy:
    on_alert: immediate
    fallback_model: family-a-compat
```
Priya Raman: good. Sales also wants a canned customer message for each lane. can marketing draft templates for FAST/STD/HOLD with clear timelines and incentives?
Lena Cho: assign to Elena for comms drafts. include a FAQ about "what happens if an app breaks" and link to rollback runbook.
Tom Becker: preflight checklist to gate rollout: tokenization checksum, kv-migration-test, perf smoke under 1x and 2x load, eval harness deterministic pass. Also require human review for any open-ended QA samples.
rollout-bot: queued: run_suite "catalog-move-smoke" on ded-cluster-x, eta 4200102090
Ravi K: add telemetry requirements: capture request_id, model_variant, fallback_used, and annotate events with "migration_lane" tag for billing reconciliation.
Elena M: incentives proposal: FAST -> 20% credits for 60 days; STANDARD -> 10% credits for 30 days; HOLD -> no credits but extended support window. run by finance/legal.
Priya Raman: also propose a "migration window": customers can opt into FAST during first 14d of canary, STANDARD during 45d, after that move to HOLD unless exception approved. makes comms simple.
Tom Becker: on deprecations: require a sunset calendar entry and an auto-notify 90/45/14 day cadence. if customer in HOLD, send notifications but don't auto-migrate.
rollout-bot: run complete: median 130ms, p95 175ms, eval_f1_drop 1.1%, hallucination_rate stable -> PASS for STANDARD lane thresholds
Lena Cho: nice. next owners: Tom -> finalize preflight scripts, Ravi -> telemetry tags + billing mapping, Elena -> comms + templates, Priya -> sales playbook + contract clause. I'll add these to the board and schedule a follow-up sync next Tue 10am PT. Keep updates here. :rocket:
